items.title: The influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioception on walking capacity in children with and without upper motor neuron lesions.
items.summary: Gait stability depends on the integration of visual and proprioceptive feedback. Children with upper motor neuron (UMN) lesions often exhibit proprioceptive deficits; however, the interaction between these deficits and visual input during walking remains unclear. This study investigated the influence of visual restriction and lower-limb proprioceptive function on walking capacity in children with UMN lesions compared to typically developing (TD) peers. In this cross-sectional study, 42 children with UMN lesions and 49 TD peers completed the 10-Meter Walk Test under normal and reduced visual conditions. We calculated absolute and relative (reduced vision/normal vision) gait capacity metrics. Proprioception was assessed at the hip, knee, and ankle using joint movement sense (JMS), joint position sense (JPS), and dynamic position sense (DPS). Spearman correlations examined relationships between proprioception and gait capacity. Both groups walked slower and took shorter steps under reduced vision; however, children with UMN lesions exhibited larger changes (p < 0.001). In these children, proprioceptive modalities showed weak-to-moderate correlations with gait parameters that strengthened under visual restriction, a pattern observed in pooled analyses. JMS showed the strongest, though weak, correlation with relative walking speed. Joint-specific analyses showed the strongest correlations at the more affected ankle and the less affected hip in children with UMN lesions. Children with UMN lesions rely more on proprioceptive input for gait under reduced vision, with the less affected hip and more affected ankle possibly compensating for deficits. Interventions targeting proprioception may enhance walking performance under varying sensory conditions.

items.titleZh: 视觉限制与下肢本体感觉对伴或不伴上运动神经元损伤儿童步行能力的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究纳入42名上运动神经元损伤儿童和49名典型发育儿童，比较正常与视觉减弱条件下的10米步行表现，并评估髋、膝、踝本体感觉。结果显示两组在视觉受限时均走得更慢、步幅更短，但上运动神经元损伤儿童变化更大；其本体感觉与步态参数呈弱至中度相关，且在视觉受限时相关性增强，提示这些儿童在视觉输入减少时更依赖本体感觉，受累较轻的髋和受累较重的踝可能参与代偿。
items.insight: 该研究提示，上运动神经元损伤儿童的步行控制更依赖本体感觉代偿，且这种依赖在视觉受限时更明显。对ALS研究者而言，这为理解上运动神经元受累相关的感觉-运动整合障碍提供了可借鉴的评估框架，并提示本体感觉训练或感觉条件适配可能成为步行功能干预的候选方向；但研究为横断面设计，不能推断因果或疗效。

aiRead.keyFinding: 上运动神经元损伤儿童在视觉减弱下步行能力下降更明显，本体感觉与步态参数呈弱至中度相关且视觉受限时相关性增强，提示更依赖本体感觉代偿。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果；样本为儿童上运动神经元损伤人群，非ALS队列；相关性总体较弱，结论外推需谨慎。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对本体感觉的干预研究，以及在不同感觉条件下评估ALS上运动神经元受累人群步行与平衡功能的纵向研究。

items.abstractZh: 步态稳定性依赖于视觉与本体感觉反馈的整合。上运动神经元（UMN）损伤儿童常存在本体感觉缺陷；然而，这些缺陷与视觉输入在步行中的交互作用仍不清楚。本研究比较了UMN损伤儿童与典型发育（TD）同龄儿童，探讨视觉限制和下肢本体感觉功能对步行能力的影响。在这项横断面研究中，42名UMN损伤儿童和49名TD同龄儿童在正常和视觉减弱条件下完成10米步行测试。我们计算了绝对和相对（减弱视觉/正常视觉）步态能力指标。采用关节运动觉（JMS）、关节位置觉（JPS）和动态位置觉（DPS）评估髋、膝和踝的本体感觉。采用Spearman相关分析检验本体感觉与步态能力之间的关系。两组在视觉减弱条件下均行走更慢、步幅更短；然而，UMN损伤儿童的变化更大（p < 0.001）。在这些儿童中，各本体感觉模态与步态参数呈弱至中度相关，且在视觉限制下相关性增强，这一模式在合并分析中可见。JMS与相对步行速度的相关性最强，但仍为弱相关。关节特异性分析显示，UMN损伤儿童中相关性最强的是受累更重的踝关节和受累较轻的髋关节。UMN损伤儿童在视觉减弱下步行更依赖本体感觉输入，受累较轻的髋关节和受累较重的踝关节可能代偿缺陷。针对本体感觉的干预可能改善不同感觉条件下的步行表现。
items.frontierRationale: 新近研究聚焦上运动神经元损伤儿童在视觉限制下的本体感觉-步态交互，为ALS上运动神经元受累相关的感觉运动整合与康复评估提供转化线索。

items.title: Protein disulphide isomerase protects against ALS/FTD phenotypes associated with cyclin F in zebrafish and cellular models.
items.summary: Mutations in CCNF , encoding cyclin F, cause a small proportion of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) cases. Mutant cyclin F mislocalises from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, impairs the ubiquitin proteasome system, disrupts endoplasmic reticulum (ER) to Golgi transport, and triggers ER stress and apoptosis. Protein disulphide isomerase (PDI), a redox-active ER chaperone of the thioredoxin superfamily, protects against ALS phenotypes induced by mutant SOD1, TDP-43, and FUS, but its activity against mutant cyclin F has not been examined. To test whether PDI overexpression prevents the cellular and behavioural phenotypes induced by the ALS/FTD-associated cyclin F S621G mutation. Neuro-2a cells were co-transfected with mCherry-tagged wild-type or mutant cyclin F S621G and V5-tagged PDI or empty vector. Subcellular localisation, XBP-1 and CHOP activation, proteasome reporter (GFPu) accumulation, nuclear morphology, and cleaved caspase-3 immunoreactivity were assessed by confocal microscopy. Transient transgenic zebrafish larvae generated by mRNA co-injection of cyclin F and PDI were assessed by photomotor response at 48 h post-fertilisation. Mutant cyclin F S621G induced cytoplasmic mislocalisation, ER stress (assessed by XBP-1 and CHOP activation), proteasome dysfunction (indicated by GFPu accumulation), and apoptosis (assessed by nuclear condensation and caspase-3 activation), all of which were significantly attenuated by PDI co-expression. Zebrafish larvae expressing cyclin F S621G swam significantly shorter distances than uninjected or wildtype controls, and co-expression of PDI restored motor function to near-wildtype levels. PDI protects against ALS/FTD-associated mutant cyclin F in both cellular and in vivo zebrafish models, identifying PDI as a redox-based therapeutic target for CCNF -linked ALS/FTD.
items.titleZh: 蛋白质二硫键异构酶在斑马鱼和细胞模型中保护免受与细胞周期蛋白F相关的ALS/FTD表型
items.summaryZh: 该研究在Neuro-2a细胞和斑马鱼模型中测试了蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）对CCNF基因S621G突变所致ALS/FTD表型的保护作用。结果显示，突变型细胞周期蛋白F引起细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，PDI共表达可显著减轻上述细胞表型；在斑马鱼中，PDI共表达使突变所致的运动距离缩短恢复至接近野生型水平。研究提示PDI是CCNF相关ALS/FTD的潜在氧化还原相关治疗靶点，但证据仅来自细胞和动物模型。
items.insight: CCNF突变是ALS/FTD中较少被研究的遗传亚型，目前缺乏针对性干预策略。该研究将PDI这一已在SOD1、TDP-43、FUS模型中显示保护作用的ER氧化还原伴侣拓展至细胞周期蛋白F通路，并在体内斑马鱼模型中观察到运动功能改善，为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的机制研究和靶点验证提供了可跟踪的临床前线索。

aiRead.studyType: 临床前机制研究（Neuro-2a细胞系与瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型）
aiRead.keyFinding: PDI共表达显著减轻突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导的细胞质错误定位、内质网应激、蛋白酶体功能障碍和凋亡，并使斑马鱼运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。
aiRead.limitation: 证据仅来自细胞系和瞬时转基因斑马鱼模型，尚未在患者来源细胞、稳定动物模型或临床研究中验证；PDI过表达的长期安全性和剂量效应未评估。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否在CCNF患者来源神经元或稳定动物模型中验证PDI的保护作用，以及是否开发针对PDI通路的候选干预手段。

items.abstractZh: 编码细胞周期蛋白F的CCNF基因突变导致一小部分肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）病例。突变型细胞周期蛋白F从细胞核错误定位至细胞质，损害泛素蛋白酶体系统，破坏内质网（ER）至高尔基体运输，并触发内质网应激和凋亡。蛋白质二硫键异构酶（PDI）是硫氧还蛋白超家族中一种具有氧化还原活性的内质网伴侣蛋白，可保护免受突变型SOD1、TDP-43和FUS诱导的ALS表型，但其针对突变型细胞周期蛋白F的活性尚未被研究。为检验PDI过表达是否能预防ALS/FTD相关细胞周期蛋白F S621G突变诱导的细胞和行为表型。将Neuro-2a细胞与mCherry标记的野生型或突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G以及V5标记的PDI或空载体共转染。通过共聚焦显微镜评估亚细胞定位、XBP-1和CHOP激活、蛋白酶体报告基因（GFPu）积累、核形态和切割型caspase-3免疫反应性。通过mRNA共注射细胞周期蛋白F和PDI生成的瞬时转基因斑马鱼幼鱼在受精后48小时通过光运动反应进行评估。突变型细胞周期蛋白F S621G诱导细胞质错误定位、内质网应激（通过XBP-1和CHOP激活评估）、蛋白酶体功能障碍（通过GFPu积累指示）和凋亡（通过核浓缩和caspase-3激活评估），所有这些均被PDI共表达显著减弱。表达细胞周期蛋白F S621G的斑马鱼幼鱼游动距离显著短于未注射或野生型对照，而PDI共表达使运动功能恢复至接近野生型水平。PDI在细胞和体内斑马鱼模型中均保护免受ALS/FTD相关突变型细胞周期蛋白F的影响，将PDI确定为CCNF相关ALS/FTD的基于氧化还原的治疗靶点。
items.frontierRationale: 新近在细胞和斑马鱼模型中证明PDI可减轻CCNF相关ALS/FTD表型，为这一少见遗传亚型提供了基于氧化还原的转化候选靶点。

items.title: Black Myrobalan ( Terminalia chebula ) as a potential multitarget neuroprotective agent: Translational insights and future directions in neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: Myrobalan or Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula Retz. ) has been integrated into Ayurvedic, Unani, and even Tibetan medicine systems for over 2000 years. The "King of Medicines" has traditionally been used for diverse ailments such as digestive issues, wound healing, and general body strengthening. Now, modern medicine is focusing on the myrobalan's potential neuroprotective properties and its use in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Huntington's, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) neurodegenerative disorders. These ailments are characterized by some combination of enduring oxidative damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, neuroinflammation, irregular protein aggregation, and progressive neuron cell death. Most of the current treatment options revolve around addressing the symptoms of the diseases, which is insufficient as the underlying disease continues to progress. There is an urgent need to devise therapies that work simultaneously on multiple disease pathways. Some of the noted secondary metabolites in T. chebula include hydrolyzable tannins like chebulinic and chebulagic acid as well as corilagin. Others occur as phenolic acids such as gallic and ellagic acid and flavonoids quercetin and kaempferol. Moreover, glycosides, sterols, and a wide range of alkaloids are also present. A number of these compounds are known to possess multifunctional biological properties like scavenging ROS, activating Nrf2/ARE signaling, downregulating pro-inflammatory mediators through blockade of NF-κB, and exerting protective effects on the mitochondria, as well as modulating apoptosis via Bcl-2 and caspases. T. chebula extracts and some isolated compounds have also been shown to improve cognitive function, reduce neuroinflammation, and protect dopaminergic neurons, and ameliorate neurotoxic effects of amyloid-β or α-synuclein through in vitro and in vivo animal studies. A review of the contributions from the phytochemistry, mechanism of action, preclinical, translational, and adjunctive applications of Terminalia chebula in neurodegenerative disease therapy is presented here.

items.titleZh: 诃子（Terminalia chebula）作为潜在的多靶点神经保护剂：神经退行性疾病中的转化研究启示与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理诃子（Terminalia chebula）的植物化学成分及其在神经退行性疾病中的多靶点神经保护潜力。文章指出，诃子中的鞣质、酚酸和黄酮等成分在临床前研究中显示出抗氧化、抗炎、线粒体保护、调节凋亡和减少蛋白聚集等作用，并在动物模型中改善认知、保护多巴胺能神经元。文章强调现有治疗多为对症，亟需多通路干预策略，但所引证据主要来自体外和动物研究，尚未提供临床疗效证据。
items.insight: 对ALS研究者而言，这篇综述的价值在于把诃子及其活性成分（如诃子酸、柯里拉京、鞣花酸）与ALS相关的氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症和蛋白稳态失衡等通路联系起来，为多靶点候选天然产物提供了机制假说和临床前证据地图。但需注意，文中ALS相关证据仍停留在体外和动物层面，不能据此推断临床获益；后续应关注其活性成分在ALS模型中的剂量、暴露和安全性数据，以及是否进入正规临床试验。

items.abstractZh: 诃子（Myrobalan 或 Haritaki，Terminalia chebula Retz.）已被整合进阿育吠陀、尤纳尼乃至藏医药体系超过2000年。这种“药物之王”传统上用于治疗消化问题、伤口愈合和全身强壮等多种疾患。如今，现代医学正关注诃子的潜在神经保护特性及其在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、亨廷顿病和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）等神经退行性疾病中的应用。这些疾病以持续性氧化损伤、线粒体功能障碍、神经炎症、异常蛋白聚集和进行性神经元细胞死亡中的若干组合为特征。目前大多数治疗方案围绕缓解疾病症状，这并不充分，因为 underlying 疾病仍在持续进展。迫切需要设计能同时作用于多条疾病通路的疗法。T. chebula 中一些值得注意的次生代谢物包括可水解鞣质如诃子酸（chebulinic acid）和诃黎勒酸（chebulagic acid）以及柯里拉京（corilagin）。其他包括酚酸如没食子酸和鞣花酸，以及黄酮类槲皮素和山奈酚。此外，还含有糖苷、甾醇和多种生物碱。其中许多化合物已知具有多功能生物学特性，如清除ROS、激活Nrf2/ARE信号、通过阻断NF-κB下调促炎介质、对线粒体发挥保护作用，以及通过Bcl-2和caspase调节凋亡。T. chebula 提取物和一些分离化合物在体外和体内动物研究中还显示可改善认知功能、减少神经炎症、保护多巴胺能神经元，并改善淀粉样蛋白-β或α-突触核蛋白的神经毒性效应。本文综述了 Terminalia chebula 在神经退行性疾病治疗中的植物化学、作用机制、临床前、转化和辅助应用方面的贡献。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了诃子多靶点神经保护机制与ALS等神经退行性疾病的转化研究方向，为天然产物多通路干预提供了可跟踪的临床前依据。

items.title: Rethinking Digital Outcome Measures for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trials: Consensus Priorities for Actigraphy Harmonization, Validation, and Regulatory Readiness.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trials need outcome measures that complement established end points while capturing how people function in daily life. In this viewpoint, we draw on our collective experience in ALS research, clinical trials, digital-measure development, and regulatory science, together with published evidence, a preliminary patient survey, stakeholder discussions, and experience from multisite actigraphy studies. We argue that the field now has a substantial base of longitudinal data and candidate measures, but lacks the coordinated framework needed to compare, prioritize, and validate them across studies. We identify 4 linked priorities: adopt fit-for-purpose measures in stages and within defined contexts of use; harmonize data collection and analysis; use data to shortlist and validate measures across cohorts; and prepare actigraphy methods for trial adoption through early industry and regulatory engagement. Across these priorities, actigraphy should complement rather than replace established clinical outcomes, with its integration guided by patient relevance, ALS phenotypic heterogeneity, participant, and caregiver burden, and the intended context of use. Our central message is that progress now depends less on generating additional isolated datasets or measures than on coordinating the evaluation of existing assets, and aligning future evidence generation.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）临床试验需要能够补充现有终点、同时捕捉人们在日常生活中功能状况的结局指标。在这篇观点文章中，我们基于在ALS研究、临床试验、数字指标开发和监管科学方面的集体经验，结合已发表证据、一项初步患者调查、利益相关者讨论以及多中心活动记录仪研究的经验，提出：该领域现已拥有大量纵向数据和候选指标，但缺乏跨研究比较、优先排序和验证这些指标所需的协调框架。我们确定了四个相互关联的优先事项：在明确的使用场景中分阶段采用适合目的的指标；协调数据收集与分析；利用数据在队列间筛选和验证指标；通过早期行业和监管参与，为活动记录仪方法在试验中的采用做好准备。在这些优先事项中，活动记录仪应补充而非替代已确立的临床结局，其整合应以患者相关性、ALS表型异质性、参与者和照护者负担以及预期使用场景为指导。我们的核心信息是：现在的进展较少依赖于生成更多孤立的数据集或指标，而更多依赖于协调现有资产的评估，并协调未来证据的生成。

items.title: The Boron-Neuron Connection: The Potential of Boron-Containing Molecules for Treating Incurable Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Boron (B), a group 13 metalloid, has emerged as a versatile element at the intersection of chemistry, biology, and medicine. Its electron-deficient nature and ability to reversibly interconvert between trigonal planar (sp 2 ) and tetrahedral (sp 3 ) geometries enable dynamic covalent interactions with biological nucleophiles, making boron-containing compounds (BCCs) attractive pharmacophores that selectively interact with reactive oxygen species (ROS) and are ROS-responsive for therapeutic development. BCCs possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and metal-chelating properties that make them attractive candidates for neurodegenerative diseases. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a fatal and multifactorial motor neurodegenerative disorder, is characterized by oxidative stress, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and metal dyshomeostasis, providing a strong rationale for exploring boron-based therapeutics. This review examines current literature on B chemistry, pharmacology, and translational applications, with emphasis on mechanisms relevant to ALS pathogenesis. This review focuses on ROS-responsive B scaffolds, blood-brain barrier (BBB) permeability, neuroprotective mechanisms, hormonal modulation, metal chelation, and emerging preclinical evidence supporting boron-based interventions. BCCs represent a promising yet underexplored therapeutic platform for ALS and related neurodegenerative disorders. Their ROS-responsive, redox-modulating, and neuroprotective properties, combined with favorable CNS drug-like pharmacokinetics, offer a mechanistically distinct approach to disease modification. Emerging preclinical evidence strongly supports further translational investigation.
items.titleZh: 硼-神经元连接：含硼分子治疗不可治愈的肌萎缩侧索硬化症的潜力
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇综述，系统梳理含硼化合物在ALS治疗中的潜在价值。文章指出，硼元素独特的化学性质使其化合物能响应活性氧、抗炎、抗氧化并螯合金属，而这些都是ALS病理中的关键环节。综述还讨论了血脑屏障通透性、神经保护机制和临床前证据，认为含硼分子是值得进一步转化研究的新方向。

items.abstractZh: 硼（B）是一种第13族类金属，已成为化学、生物学和医学交叉领域中的多功能元素。其缺电子性质以及在三角平面（sp2）和四面体（sp3）几何构型之间可逆互变的能力，使其能够与生物亲核试剂发生动态共价相互作用，从而使含硼化合物（BCCs）成为有吸引力的药效团，可选择性地与活性氧（ROS）相互作用，并具有ROS响应性，可用于治疗开发。BCCs具有抗氧化、抗炎和金属螯合特性，使其成为神经退行性疾病的有吸引力候选物。肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种致命的多因素运动神经退行性疾病，以氧化应激、神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和金属稳态失衡为特征，为探索硼基治疗提供了强有力的理由。本综述考察了关于B化学、药理学和转化应用的当前文献，重点关注与ALS发病机制相关的机制。本综述聚焦于ROS响应性硼骨架、血脑屏障（BBB）通透性、神经保护机制、激素调节、金属螯合以及支持硼基干预的新兴临床前证据。BCCs代表了一个有前景但尚未充分探索的ALS及相关神经退行性疾病治疗平台。其ROS响应性、氧化还原调节和神经保护特性，加上良好的中枢神经系统药物样药代动力学，提供了一种机制上独特的疾病修饰方法。新兴的临床前证据强烈支持进一步的转化研究。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，系统提出ROS响应性含硼分子作为ALS疾病修饰的新机制平台，具有明确的转化研究价值。

items.title: Novel compounds induce AChR clustering and improve motor function in myasthenia gravis animal models.
items.summary: The neuromuscular junction (NMJ), the synapse between motor nerves and skeletal muscles, is implicated in the pathogenesis of various neuromuscular disorders, including myasthenia gravis (MG), congenital myasthenia, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Postsynaptic clustering of acetylcholine receptors (AChRs) is crucial for NMJ formation. This process is initiated by agrin, a glycoprotein secreted from motor nerve terminals, which activates muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) via its coreceptor, low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 (Lrp4), and thereby activates downstream signaling pathways that induce AChR clustering. MG is an autoimmune disease characterized by the production of autoantibodies against NMJ components such as AChR, MuSK, and Lrp4, which leads to impaired neuromuscular transmission and motor dysfunction. In this study, we identified orally active small-molecule compounds that promote AChR clustering through the Lrp4-MuSK signaling axis. Knockdown experiments demonstrated that Lrp4 was responsible for the compounds to induce AChR clustering. The compounds induced MuSK phosphorylation following the compound treatment in C2C12 cells and improved motor function and increased muscle volume in both MuSK-MG mice and AChR-MG rat models. Together, these findings identify orally active small molecules that potentiate Lrp4-MuSK signaling and highlight a pharmacological strategy to modulate NMJ function for MG and related neuromuscular disorders.

items.abstractZh: 神经肌肉接头（NMJ）是运动神经与骨骼肌之间的突触，参与多种神经肌肉疾病的发病机制，包括重症肌无力（MG）、先天性肌无力综合征和肌萎缩侧索硬化。突触后乙酰胆碱受体（AChR）的聚集对NMJ形成至关重要。该过程由运动神经末梢分泌的糖蛋白agrin启动，agrin通过其共受体低密度脂蛋白受体相关蛋白4（Lrp4）激活肌肉特异性酪氨酸激酶（MuSK），进而激活下游信号通路诱导AChR聚集。MG是一种自身免疫性疾病，其特征是产生针对NMJ组分（如AChR、MuSK和Lrp4）的自身抗体，导致神经肌肉传递受损和运动功能障碍。本研究鉴定出通过Lrp4-MuSK信号轴促进AChR聚集的口服活性小分子化合物。敲低实验证明Lrp4是这些化合物诱导AChR聚集所必需的。在C2C12细胞中，化合物处理后可诱导MuSK磷酸化；在MuSK-MG小鼠和AChR-MG大鼠模型中，化合物改善了运动功能并增加了肌肉体积。总之，这些发现鉴定出增强Lrp4-MuSK信号的口服活性小分子，并提示了一种通过调节NMJ功能治疗MG及相关神经肌肉疾病的药理学策略。
items.frontierRationale: 新近鉴定的口服小分子通过Lrp4-MuSK轴增强NMJ信号，在重症肌无力动物模型中改善运动功能，并为ALS等NMJ相关疾病提供可转化的药理学思路。

items.title: From technique to sensitivity: the transformation of clinical and ethical reasoning in physiotherapy students in the context of chronic neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary: The evolution of Physiotherapy requires a shift from the biomedical model towards bioethical and humanistic approaches. This study explores how final-year students perceive their professional role when dealing with patients with complex neurodegenerative conditions, where traditional technical success is challenged by the irreversibility of the deterioration. Qualitative research based on interpretative description. Thirty final-year students from the University of Almería (Spain) took part, divided into five working groups. Three training sessions and discussions were held on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), Alzheimer's disease, stroke and Rett syndrome. The data were analysed using thematic analysis and triangulation by researchers external to the study, with reflexivity ensured through logbooks. A shift in clinical reasoning was identified, with sensitivity taking precedence over technique. Students redefined therapeutic success in terms of "comfort" and support, valuing "microscopic achievements" such as the preservation of dignity and the alleviation of distress. Of particular note is the ability to adapt ethical principles according to the patient's cognitive integrity (autonomy in ALS versus protection in Alzheimer's) and the integration of the carer as an inseparable part of the therapeutic process. Future physiotherapists perceive humanization and the empathetic interpretation of non-verbal cues as essential therapeutic tools. Unlike previous studies focused on clinical experience, this research explores pre-clinical ethical maturation, offering a unique perspective on the educational foundation and humanistic predisposition of future graduates prior to their immersion in the healthcare system. It is imperative that academic curricula formally integrate competencies in bioethics, palliative care and emotional management to prepare graduates for extreme vulnerability and prevent early professional burnout.

items.abstractZh: 物理治疗的发展要求从生物医学模式转向生命伦理与人本主义方法。本研究探讨毕业年级学生如何看待自己在面对复杂神经退行性疾病患者时的职业角色，在这些情境中，传统意义上的技术成功受到疾病不可逆恶化的挑战。研究采用基于解释性描述的定性研究方法。来自西班牙阿尔梅里亚大学的30名毕业年级学生参与研究，分为五个工作组。围绕肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）、阿尔茨海默病、卒中和Rett综合征开展了三次培训课程和讨论。数据采用主题分析和由研究外部研究者进行的三角验证进行分析，并通过日志记录确保反身性。研究发现临床推理发生了转变，敏感性优先于技术。学生将治疗成功重新定义为“舒适”和支持，重视“微观成就”，如维护尊严和减轻痛苦。尤其值得注意的是，学生能够根据患者的认知完整性调整伦理原则（ALS中的自主权与阿尔茨海默病中的保护），并将照护者整合为治疗过程中不可分割的一部分。未来的物理治疗师将人文化和共情解读非语言线索视为 essential 的治疗工具。与以往聚焦临床经验的研究不同，本研究探讨了临床前的伦理成熟过程，为未来毕业生在进入医疗系统之前的教育基础和人本主义倾向提供了独特视角。学术课程必须正式整合生命伦理、姑息治疗和情绪管理能力，以使毕业生为应对极端脆弱性做好准备，并预防早期职业倦怠。

items.title: UNC13A splice correction rescues synaptic dysfunction induced by TDP-43 loss.
items.summary: TDP-43 nuclear depletion is a defining pathological feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia that induces widespread cryptic splicing defects in hundreds of transcripts 1-8 . Despite this, whether TDP-43 loss affects synaptic function has remained unclear. Here we show that TDP-43 loss induces a predegenerative state in which neurons remain structurally intact but suffer a substantial breakdown in synaptic communication. Genetic correction of a single cryptic splicing event in UNC13A was sufficient to rescue these deficits. We developed splice-switching antisense oligonucleotides that correct UNC13A cryptic splicing in human cortical and spinal motor neurons and in a humanized mouse model. In human neurons this intervention restored spontaneous and evoked synaptic vesicle release, release probability at individual synapses and wider network synchrony. Together, this establishes UNC13A splice correction as a mechanistically defined and genetically validated therapeutic strategy relevant to roughly 97% of patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and roughly 50% of patients with frontotemporal dementia with TDP-43 pathology.

items.abstractZh: TDP-43核内耗竭是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的标志性病理特征，可导致数百种转录本出现广泛的隐蔽剪接缺陷。尽管如此，TDP-43缺失是否影响突触功能此前仍不清楚。本研究表明，TDP-43缺失会诱导一种前退行性状态：神经元在结构上保持完整，但突触通讯出现显著障碍。对UNC13A单个隐蔽剪接事件进行遗传学校正，足以挽救这些缺陷。我们开发了剪接转换反义寡核苷酸（ASO），可在人皮层神经元、脊髓运动神经元以及人源化小鼠模型中校正UNC13A隐蔽剪接。在人神经元中，该干预恢复了自发性和诱发性突触囊泡释放、单个突触的释放概率以及更广泛的网络同步性。综上，本研究将UNC13A剪接校正确立为一种机制明确、经遗传学验证的治疗策略，适用于约97%伴TDP-43病理的ALS患者和约50%伴TDP-43病理的FTD患者。
items.frontierRationale: 新近发表于Nature的研究在人类神经元和人源化小鼠中证明，校正UNC13A隐蔽剪接可挽救TDP-43缺失导致的突触功能障碍，具有明确的ALS转化价值。

items.title: TNIP1 acts as an aggrephagy receptor that assembles clearance machinery for protein aggregate removal.
items.summary: Selective autophagy receptors recognize and recruit harmful intracellular components to autophagosomes for degradation, and their dysfunction is linked to neurodegeneration, metabolic disorders, and cancer. Here, we identified TNFAIP3 interacting protein 1 (TNIP1) as an aggrephagy receptor implicated in neurodegenerative diseases. TNIP1 accumulated at polyubiquitinated protein aggregates upon proteotoxic stress. Genetic depletion of TNIP1 reduced protein aggregate clearance and increased axonal degeneration under proteotoxic stress. Mechanistically, TNIP1 enhanced protein aggregate clearance by assembling aggrephagy receptors, such as SQSTM1/p62 and TAX1BP1, onto protein aggregates. Gene expression analysis revealed that TNIP1 expression levels are reduced in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) with TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) inclusion pathology. Additionally, an ALS-associated TNIP1 mutant exhibited impaired association with TDP-43 aggregates and failed to rescue their autophagy-mediated degradation. These findings establish TNIP1 as an aggrephagy receptor and reveal its potential role as a therapeutic target for ALS and other proteinopathies.

items.title: Impaired discrimination of negative facial emotions in pure motor ALS.
items.summary: Emotion recognition deficits in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) remain debated. We investigated whether patients with pure motor ALS (without cognitive and behavioural disturbances) and without clinically relevant mood disturbances are impaired in discriminating negative facial emotions, using a test without ceiling effects. This cross-sectional study included 35 patients with pure motor ALS, based on the revised Strong criteria and operationalised using the Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS), without clinically relevant mood disturbances, alongside 35 age-, sex-, and education-matched cognitively and psychiatrically healthy controls. All participants completed a shortened five-emotion version of the Facial Emotion Intensity Rating Test - Congruent and Incongruent and the Facial Sex Matching Task (FSMT), a brief screening measure of non-emotional facial discrimination. Pure motor ALS patients showed poorer discrimination among negative facial emotions than healthy controls (p = 0.011, Cohen's d = 0.63). The group difference did not differ significantly across anger, fear, sadness, and disgust (p = 0.178). Similarly, the group difference in discrimination among negative emotions did not differ significantly from that in discrimination between negative emotions and happiness (p = 0.459). The two groups did not differ significantly on the FSMT. Discrimination of negative facial emotions was impaired in patients with pure motor ALS, suggesting that classification based on ECAS screening may underestimate social-cognitive involvement. Our findings are compatible with the concept of an ALS-frontotemporal spectrum disorder. Whether impaired emotion discrimination relates to additional cognitive or behavioural impairment remains to be determined. The clinical utility and reliability of our measure require further study.

items.title: The neuro-inflammaging triangle: a self-amplifying circuit of protein pathology, senescence-associated secretory phenotype and innate immunity in neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, frontotemporal dementia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, share common pathological features, including abnormal protein aggregation, chronic neuroinflammation and progressive neuronal loss. Ageing is the strongest risk factor, accompanied by a chronic, mild inflammatory state called 'inflammaging,' partly due to senescent cells producing senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) factors. Innate immune DNA- and danger-sensing pathways, most notably the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-stimulator of interferon genes (cGAS-STING) pathway and NOD-like receptor family, pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasomes, convert cellular injury into chronic neuroinflammation. Here, we propose that protein pathology, SASP, and innate immune activation form a self-amplifying triangular circuit leading to age-related neurodegeneration. We present the cellular and molecular basis of each part and how microglia, astrocytes, oligodendrocyte precursor cells and neurons contribute. We outline treatment strategies, including senolytics, senomorphics, innate immune pathway inhibitors and metabolic restoration, and identify unresolved questions, including the reversibility of post-mitotic neuronal senescence, the relative contribution of each cell type and the translational challenge of interrupting the cycle. Collectively, the neuro-inflammaging triangle theory shifts focus from individual pathogenic entities to the self-amplifying circuit that sustains them, offering a unified mechanistic model to advance our understanding and treatment of age-related neurodegeneration.

items.title: Lower frequency ECoG features improve longitudinal stability of speech and hand-grasp detection in a patient with progressive ALS.
items.summary: Achieving long-term decoding stability is a critical challenge for chronicintracranial brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). High-gamma (HG) activity fromintracranial recordings is the standard signal for BCI control, and lower-frequency featurescan enhance HG decoding performance. This study evaluated the longitudinal stability ofspeech and hand-grasp detection models using individual and joint spectral features, andthe local motor potential (LMP).Approach. Longitudinal data from a single participant implanted with two 64-channelECoG arrays were used to evaluate the long-term stability of logistic regression models forspeech and hand-grasp detection. Models were trained on individual frequency bands andon the LMP, a time-domain low-frequency feature, and evaluated over 21 months forspeech and 13 months for grasp. The best-performing band features were then combinedinto multi-band models and analyzed for their spatial contributions.Main Results. The LMP yielded the most accurate single feature models in both tasks(speech 93.8%, grasp 99.4%) and showed little or no decline. Multi-band modelscombining HG with lower frequency bands were substantially more stable than HG-onlymodels and outperformed the LMP models for speech but not grasp. HG accuracydegraded strongly for both tasks (speech:-4.3 percentage points per 100 days, or pp/100d,grasp:-3.4 pp/100d). HG+beta for speech showed a negligible decline (-0.5 pp/100d,95.6% ±0.06% overall), and for grasp, delta alone showed remarkable stability (+0.5pp/100d), while HG+beta+delta maintained 98.2 ±0.09% overall accuracy with flatperformance (+0.0 pp/100d). The advantage of the multi-band models increased overtime, reaching +20.6 pp for speech and +10.2 pp for grasp in the last 100 days.Significance. Incorporating lower-frequency neural activity yields more stable long-termspeech and grasp detection than HG alone. These findings indicate that lower-frequencyand multi-band features may reduce recalibration requirements for simple BCI tasks, andmay complement the precision control provided by HG activity.

items.title: Carbon dot-based nanomaterials in neurodegeneration: addressing neurobiological barriers and targeting challenges.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, represent a major global health challenge due to their progressive nature and limited therapeutic options. One of the primary obstacles to treating these disorders is the blood-brain barrier (BBB), which restricts the delivery of most therapeutic agents into the central nervous system. In recent years, carbon-based nanomaterials, particularly carbon dot (CD) nanostructures, have emerged as promising platforms for neurological applications owing to their ultrasmall size, BBB-crossing ability, and anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties, in addition to tunable surface chemistry, strong photoluminescence, and favorable biocompatibility. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent research developments in the application of CD-based nanomaterials, including carbon nanodots, carbon quantum dots, graphene quantum dots, and carbon polymer dots, for the potential treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. The synthesis strategies and carbonization approaches used to produce these carbon nanomaterials are discussed, along with their physicochemical properties relevant to neurobiological applications, such as particle size, surface functionalization, heteroatom doping, optical properties, and stability in biological environments. Furthermore, the mechanisms by which CD-based nanomaterials can traverse the BBB are examined, including receptor-mediated and adsorptive-mediated transcytosis pathways. In addition, their applications are discussed, with particular focus on their roles in bioimaging, biosensing, inhibition of pathological protein aggregation, antioxidative activity, and targeted drug delivery. Finally, key challenges related to toxicity, biodistribution, large-scale synthesis, and clinical translation are discussed, along with future perspectives for the development of multifunctional theranostic platforms. Overall, use of CD-based nanomaterials represents a promising emerging strategy for overcoming neurobiological barriers and enabling the development of next-generation nanotherapeutics for the management of neurodegenerative diseases.
